skills.name: banking-business-model
skills.description: 建立银行客户、账户、存款支付结算、授信、贷款、还款及担保的业务实体关系与生命周期。用于银行业务建模和数据域边界设计；不替代机构特定会计或监管规则，不生成数据库语法。

skills.name: credit-risk-knowledge
skills.description: 整理借款人、授信机构、贷款授信、还款、担保、征信、多头/关联借贷、集团风险和共债的建模口径。用于信用风险概念与时序关系设计；不做自动授信拒绝或把风险信号当确定事实。

skills.name: cybersecurity-domain-knowledge
skills.description: 用于软件供应链与漏洞本体建模，厘清SPDX文档/组件身份、CSAF产品通告与版本、CVSS严重度和部署修复证据；适用于SBOM字段对齐和状态口径审查，不推断实际入侵或自动修复。

skills.name: electric-power-domain-knowledge
skills.description: 梳理电力设备、端子、连接点、拓扑版本、开关状态、电源/分布式电源、回路、供电点、客户与停复电的业务语义。用于电力领域术语澄清和数据库中立建模；不提供调度、倒闸指令或电气安全结论。

skills.name: entity-relationship-modeling
skills.description: 设计实体、关系方向、基数、关系属性与稳定主键。用于概念到实体关系模型的细化、实体和属性取舍及过度建模检查；不用于行业事实检索或 GQL 语法生成。

skills.name: fibo-ontology
skills.description: 解析并裁剪 FIBO 模块、Class、Object/Datatype Property、Domain/Range、SubClass 和 OWL Restriction，对齐业务扩展并记录属性图映射损失。用于 FIBO 标准驱动建模与版本差异；不分发完整 FIBO、不生成 GQL。

skills.name: finance-domain-knowledge
skills.description: 理解金融机构、产品、市场、交易、合同、债权债务、账户、授信、贷款、担保和结算的概念与边界。用于金融业务术语澄清和概念关系整理；不提供投资决策、监管结论或数据库语法。

skills.name: financial-regulatory-reporting
skills.description: 设计中国金融监管报送的制度版本、指标上下文、源数据到报表血缘、勾稽质量、更正提交与监管回执图模型。用于监管统计数据治理、报送差错追溯和影响分析；不代替正式报表模板、法律适用确认或自动报送。

skills.name: fraud-network-modeling
skills.description: 为团伙欺诈调查设计主体、共享标识、交易、控制关系、证据路径和风险子图。用于异常关联网络与团伙假设的建模及反证设计；不将共享 IP/电话、社区发现或资金链自动判定为欺诈。

skills.name: healthcare-care-pathway-modeling
skills.description: 为医疗照护路径的数据追踪设计数据库中立图模型，区分患者身份、重复就诊、医嘱请求、实际执行记录、观测结果版本、健康问题断言和证据来源。用于 FHIR R4 数据血缘、撤销请求/录入错误/缺失结果/单位不一致及版本纠正建模；不输出临床治疗路径、自动诊断、完整 FHIR 认证或生产操作。

skills.name: healthcare-domain-knowledge
skills.description: 为医疗健康数据本体设计厘清 Patient、Encounter、ServiceRequest、Observation、Procedure、Condition 与记录证据的身份、生命周期和时间语义。用于审阅脱敏数据字典、FHIR R4 字段映射、医嘱与执行混淆、结果版本/缺失/单位或患者跨系统匹配问题；不提供诊断、治疗建议或完整 FHIR 合规认证。

skills.name: industry-knowledge-discovery
skills.description: 从业务材料抽取术语、概念和规则，检索行业标准并记录来源、版本、权威性与知识缺口。用于陌生行业调研和可追溯知识整理；不承担数据库查询生成。

skills.name: logistics-domain-knowledge
skills.description: 为物流本体或业务图整理Shipment、Consignment、物流单元、路段、订舱单证与可见性事件的身份、时间和来源边界。用于物流术语澄清、数据字典对齐和概念建模；不从计划事件推断实际交付。

skills.name: manufacturing-domain-knowledge
skills.description: 梳理制造物料、批次、生产订单、消耗/产出/转化、拆分合并返工、设备资源、检验与召回的身份和数量语义。用于制造领域知识整理和数据库中立建模；不把共享设备视为物料血缘，不提供生产控制或法定质量结论。

skills.name: manufacturing-quality-traceability
skills.description: 建立物料批次、投入产出事件、拆分合并返工、设备、检验规格与召回候选的图模型和数量核对。用于质量追溯和召回范围建模；不因共用设备合并批次，不把标准背景当作本地质量阈值或批准决定。

skills.name: multi-lending-detection
skills.description: 为多头借贷识别设计借款人、机构、授信、申请、放款、征信、手机与收款账户的时序图模型及风险口径。用于多机构重叠负债、行为顺序和共债关联建模；不把查询/申请或共享标识直接视为借贷事实。

skills.name: ontology-documentation
skills.description: 把已有概念本体、属性图规格、来源与验证结论整理成可审查的设计文档。用于术语表、实体关系目录、映射和质量报告交付；不补造缺失业务事实或数据库验证结果。

skills.name: ontology-evolution
skills.description: 比较本体和属性图版本，评估概念、身份、关系、约束及标准版本升级的兼容影响。用于本体差异分析、迁移与回滚规划；不擅自执行数据库迁移或修改生产数据。

skills.name: ontology-modeling
skills.description: 从业务需求建立概念本体、概念层次、实体身份与生命周期。用于业务概念抽取、本体边界和概念模型设计；不用于数据库语法生成。

skills.name: ontology-validation
skills.description: 审查概念本体与属性图模型的业务完整性、身份、关系、类型、冗余及标准映射损失。用于模型质量验收和 Graph Model Specification 复核；不宣称静态检查等于 OWL 推理或数据库运行验证。

skills.name: power-outage-impact-analysis
skills.description: 为停电影响候选分析建立带版本的设备/端子/连接点、开关/电源状态、供电点/客户/回路和恢复分段图模型。用于计划或实际停电的范围、未知反送电和时长证据分析；不生成倒闸指令或证明安全供电。

skills.name: property-graph-mapping
skills.description: 把概念模型或 RDF/OWL 标准本体裁剪并映射为数据库中立属性图及 Graph Model Specification。用于 Class/Property/继承/Restriction 的保真与损失分析；不生成 NebulaGraph GQL 语法。

skills.name: related-party-transaction-modeling
skills.description: 设计金融关联交易的主体、持股、控制/任职证据、交易版本、时点路径、去重金额和复核模型。用于中国银行保险监管与财务披露口径对照、关联候选和反证分析；不以共享标识或持股比例自动认定关联、违法或审批通过。

skills.name: retail-domain-knowledge
skills.description: 为零售本体或业务图整理SKU/GTIN、地点、批次、实存快照、库存运动、预留、订单销售退货与补货政策的边界。用于商品库存术语对齐与概念建模；不把在途、单据或受损退货直接当作可销售库存。

skills.name: retail-inventory-replenishment
skills.description: 为SKU/地点/批次/单位粒度的库存、预留和补货建议设计证据图与规则。用于快照加原子运动、晚到退货、受损库存、冲正和用户阈值分析；不把在途、订单或销售金额当作实存，不自动创建采购单。

skills.name: shipment-exception-analysis
skills.description: 为运输延误、转运与交付异常设计Shipment/Consignment/物流单元及计划、估计、实际事件的时序证据图。用于ETA比较、晚到乱序、消息重放、部分交付和交接追踪；不把订舱或计划到达当作实际签收。

skills.name: software-vulnerability-impact
skills.description: 用于基于SPDX与CSAF/VEX材料建立组件、部署、漏洞状态和通告修订的证据图；适用于软件供应链漏洞影响候选、晚到通告、跨文档身份和修复核对，不从缺失记录判安全或执行补丁。

skills.name: imagegen
skills.description: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or edit images for websites, games, and more
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $imagegen to make or edit an image for this project.

skills.name: openai-docs
skills.description: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex.
skills.shortDescription: Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, and self-knowledge; OpenAI APIs and ChatGPT Work. 'You'/'this app' means Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: OpenAI and Codex docs for models, skills, tasks, and setup
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OpenAI Docs for official docs lookup, questions about Codex itself or Codex surfaces, model selection, model migration, and prompt-upgrade work.

skills.name: review-agent
skills.description: Perform a read-only, defect-first review of a specified code change and return every actionable finding. Use when another agent delegates review of uncommitted changes, a base-branch diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Find actionable bugs in code changes
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $review-agent to review the requested code changes and return actionable findings.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources.

skills.name: skill-installer
skills.description: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos).
skills.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos

interface.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos
